a: Free housing and office space at Green Bank, WV (no stipend); standard stays of about three weeks
dt: Applications open Feb 1, 2027; rolling admission until spaces are full, expected to close in mid-April 2027; planned 2027 sessions run May 17 to Aug 13, 2027
e: Graduate students who work with Green Bank Observatory data or staff spend a few weeks on site, in themed blocks (pulsars and the interstellar medium; star formation, astrochemistry and technosignatures; planetary radar and radio instrumentation; HI, galaxies and interference), with a mini single-dish school and 20 m telescope observing in each block. The page states no citizenship limit.
n: Green Bank Observatory Graduate Students in Residence (Summer 2027)
unv: No exact closing date is posted (only 'mid April').
